body.statement: In the continuous extension \(\nu\downarrow0\), the treatment diffusion reduces to the control Ornstein--Uhlenbeck process, \(m_\gamma\to0\), and \(V_\gamma\to2\lambda\tau/(\lambda+\tau)^3\). For fixed \(N\), the exact prelimit Poisson martingale reduces as \(T_N\to\infty\) to the fixed-system occupation central limit theorem of Boutilier, Jonasson, Li, and Yoeli.
body.justification: These reductions prevent the critical construction from changing the known unconstrained and fixed-system limits.
body.gap: They are fidelity checks rather than standalone novelty claims.
body.consumer: Readers obtain regression tests against the closed-form control-arm and published fixed-system formulas.
